title: EFFECT OF DEXAMETASONE ON LOWER LIMB EDEMA IN PATIENTS UNDERTAKEN FOR TOTAL HIP ARTHROPLASTY
official: EFFECT OF DEXAMETASONE ON LOWER LIMB EDEMA IN PATIENTS UNDERTAKEN FOR TOTAL HIP ARTHROPLASTY
summary: Main objective: Evaluate the anti-inflammatory role of dexamethasone in reducing postoperative edema in patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Men and women aged 30-80 years
2. Patients that undergo primary total hip replacement
3. Diagnosis of primary hip osteoarthritis
4. Accept and sign the informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patient undergoing corticosteroid treatment during the last 6 months before surgery
2. Patients diagnosed with previous lymphedema
3. Patients with alterations of the cortico-adrenal axis
4. Any condition that, in the clinical judgment of the researchers, may interfere with the object of the research
5. Patients with a diagnosis of secondary osteoarthritis of the hip
6. Patients with a diagnosis of hip fracture
7. Allergic patients to Dexamethasone
8. Patients who meet the criteria for malnutrition
9. Patient with a diagnosis of Diabetes Mellitus (DM1 and DM2)
10. Patients with Congestive Heart Failure (CHF)
11. Patients with Chronic Renal Insufficiency (eGFR<60).
12. Patients with peripheral venous insufficiency
